summary.text: Patrick Lucas is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates who has represented District 24 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Lucas was born in Huntington, West Virginia, and earned a B.A. in marketing from Marshall University in 1991.
His career experience includes working as the owner and broker of Century 21 Homes and Land in Barboursville, West Virginia.
